title: Crystalline Catalyst Reactor
description: A molecular catalyst reactor where the DragonDispersion model represents a prismatic crystal catalyst and the ClearCoatCarPaint sphere represents a reflective reaction vessel. The user must balance reagent concentrations, temperature, and pressure across multiple coupled reaction stages while obeying conservation of mass, with full undo/redo support.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a Crystalline Catalyst Reactor simulation. Load DragonDispersion.glb as a central prismatic crystal catalyst hovering inside a transparent reaction chamber, and ClearCoatCarPaint.glb as the outer reflective reaction vessel surrounding it. Camera: perspective at distance 5, OrbitControls enabled. Lighting: HDR environment using PMREMGenerator with a neutral studio HDRI, plus two colored point lights (blue and amber) that shift hue based on current reaction temperature. The reactor has 5 reagent slots arranged in a ring around the vessel. Each slot is a clickable 3D sphere colored by reagent type (H2=white, O2=red, N2=blue, CH4=green, CO2=gray). A left-side HTML panel shows sliders for Temperature (200-1200K) and Pressure (1-50atm). The user must complete a 5-stage synthesis chain: Stage 1 add H2+O2, Stage 2 adjust temp to 600K, Stage 3 add CH4, Stage 4 raise pressure to 30atm, Stage 5 add N2 and lower temp to 400K. Conservation of mass must hold: total atom counts displayed in a top-right HUD must remain balanced across all transformations. When reagents react, the dragon catalyst glows (emissive intensity increases) and refractive dispersion visually intensifies. The car paint vessel shifts its clearcoat color to reflect the dominant product compound. Implement an undo/redo stack (Ctrl+Z/Ctrl+Y) that reverts any reagent addition, slider change, or stage transition. Each stage transition triggers a particle burst from the catalyst. A bottom progress bar shows current stage (1-5). Invalid combinations flash the vessel red and display an error toast. On completion, the dragon spins and emits a rainbow dispersion celebration effect. All interactions require 10-14 steps total across the 5 stages.
